title: Dulcote Quarry Walk Route

images.title: Sharon Loxton / Dulcote Quarry
images.caption: Dulcote Quarry. The quarry measures around 600 metres (2,000 ft) from West to East and around 350 metres (1,150 ft) from North to South, with an area of 18 acres (7.3 ha), which is surrounded by 80 acres (32 ha) of woodland

images.caption: Fountain at Dulcote crossroads

description: This circular walk explores Dulcote Quarry in Somerset. The quarry is located just to the south of the villages of Dulcote and Dinder. You can follow public footpaths, country lanes and the old railway line to create a circular walk around the old limestone quarry. On the walk there are some nice woodland trails and fine views to the surrounding countryside. Dulcote is located close to Wells where you could enjoy a walk around the historic cathedral.
